name: cortico-world-open-xiaoai
description: 把刷了 Open-XiaoAI 的小米音箱接进 Cortico：语音进来，回答念出去。附带桥接进程的开关与状态。/ Brings an Open-XiaoAI patched Xiaomi speaker into Cortico: voice in, spoken answers out.

zh.description: 把刷了 Open-XiaoAI 的小米音箱接进来：它把听到的话送进来，把回答念出去。桥接进程由这个 World 起停，配置面板里能看状态。

en.description: Connects an Open-XiaoAI patched Xiaomi speaker: it streams what it hears in, and speaks the answers out. This World supervises the bridge process and shows its status.
